_readme: S639 harvest side session, 2026-11-12. West Valley College: 93 of 133 passing, no reconcile entry. 27 transfer degrees (AA-T, AS-T) name the degree's 60 (or 66) and Cal-GETC with no units, and 3 local degrees name 'WVC or Cal-GETC General Education patterns' with no units; every degree page the reading quoted prints no GE figure. This read prints, in the capture's own text, how a transfer page and a local page word their general education and electives, and follows the catalog's own links to the pages that state the units of the WVC GE pattern and of Cal-GETC, so a reconcile step can quote West Valley's own words. No model call.

questions.ge_units: The units West Valley's catalog states for the WVC General Education pattern and for Cal-GETC, the words a transfer page and a local page use to name them, and whether the catalog prints the 60 as a minimum or an electives rule for degrees.
